summary: The StudentPreCertifications module manages the operations related to student certification records, including adding, editing, deleting, and displaying student certifications. The UI controls consist of a GridView to display existing certifications and a FormView for detailed operations on records.
purpose: To facilitate the management of student certification records, allowing users to view, insert, update, and delete certifications within the system.

actors.description: Handles the current session information for the user.

workflows.name: Manage Student Certifications
steps: Allow adding of new certifications through FormView.
Edit existing certifications by switching FormView to Edit mode.
Validate input data before insert or update operations.
